units.source_text: 两三个像是于黑市买卖的年轻人，

en.t: Two or three young men who seemed to be dealing on the black market,

units.source_text: 揪下了装饰在人家门前的松枝——虽已过了新年，却还没将门前的松枝取下——走了过去。

en.t: tore down the pine branches decorating people's doorways, branches that had still not been taken down though the New Year had already passed, and walked on.

units.source_text: 他们张开戴着新庆手套的巴掌，在互相竞赛。

en.t: They spread out their palms in their New Year gloves and competed with one another.

units.source_text: 一人的掌心上仅有几片松叶，另一人的掌心完整地留下一小校松枝。

en.t: In one man's palm there were only a few pine needles, while in another's palm a small pine branch remained whole.

units.source_text: 这伙黑市商人边笑边走了过去。

en.t: This group of black market dealers walked past laughing.
